title: The Secret Wife
content_zh:
Lin Ruoxi had a secret. Six years ago, while drunk at a college party, she had married a stranger in Las Vegas. The marriage was supposed to have been annulled. It was not. And now the stranger — a tall, devastatingly handsome man with an inexplicable air of authority — had just walked into her office as the new CEO.
'Hello, wife,' he said, setting down his briefcase on the desk that, until five minutes ago, had been hers.
Lin Ruoxi's assistant dropped three cups of coffee simultaneously. The entire open-plan floor fell into dead silence. Everyone had heard. 'WIFE.' The word echoed through the office like a thunderclap.
Yang Chen sat down in her chair — her chair — and propped his feet on her desk. 'You've been avoiding my calls for six years. Six years, one month, and three days. I counted.'
Lin Ruoxi wanted to die. She also wanted to kill him. She hadn't decided in what order.
